prompt: What is the Java interface every concrete Sm query class implements (the marker interface for the abstract semantic query model)? Just the name.
notes: SmQuery — interface with setQueryId, getQueryId, parse(fabric, builder)

prompt: The SmQuery model uses a visitor pattern with double dispatch. What does each concrete SmQuery class do inside its parse(fabric, builder) method? One sentence.
notes: Calls fabric.get<TypeName>QueryParser().parse(...) — letting the fabric pick the right backend-specific translator

prompt: What are the four values of the SmClause.Occur enum? Comma-separated.
notes: MUST, FILTER, SHOULD, MUST_NOT — mirrors Lucene BooleanClause.Occur

prompt: When SmBooleanSolrQP translates an SmBooleanQuery to Solr, instead of inlining each clause's query string, it uses Solr named parameter references. Show the format of one clause reference inside the produced {!bool ...} string. Two-three short examples.
notes: must=$queryId, should=$queryId, filter=$queryId — refers to top-level Solr params keyed by each sub-query's queryId

prompt: ParsedQuery is a marker interface implemented by backend-specific result builders. Name the Solr-specific implementation referenced in the skill.
notes: SolrParsedQuery accumulates main query string + named params via addParameter

prompt: What is the role of QueryParserFabric<T>, and why is it parameterized by T extends ParsedQuery? One sentence.
notes: Fabric is the swap point for backend (Solr vs ES); T parameterizes the result type so the same Sm tree compiles for any backend

prompt: Why is it crucial that every SmQuery added to an SmBooleanQuery clause have its queryId set before translation? One short sentence.
notes: BooleanQuery references clauses via $queryId; null queryId → $null which Solr can't resolve

prompt: If I want to also target Elasticsearch (in addition to Solr), what three things do I need to implement? List them. Brief.
notes: EsParsedQuery (impl ParsedQuery), EsQueryParserFabric (impl QueryParserFabric<EsParsedQuery>), one Sm*EsQP per Sm subtype
